result.summary: Several layout and overflow issues: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the screen edges, and one restaurant name is truncated.

issues.description: The horizontal category chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off on the right, with a partial chip visible and no clear affordance that the list is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add padding and a fade or peek of the next chip so users can tell the row scrolls; ensure the last visible chip is not clipped.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you” (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped by the right edge of the screen, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Give the carousel enough end padding so the last fully visible card isn’t cropped, or show a partial next card as a scroll hint without cutting text.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol” is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, making the listing hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a single-line ellipsis or wrap the name so the full title remains identifiable.

issues.description: The bottom “Popular right now” promo card is cut off by the tab bar, so the offer and favorite control are only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards aren’t hidden behind navigation.
